name: us-payroll-tax-tables
title: US payroll withholding tables, 2026
description: Machine-readable federal, FICA and state income tax withholding tables for United States payroll, together with the published worked examples each verified state is checked against. Every figure was read out of a revenue department document and carries a link to it: nothing is inferred, averaged or copied from another aggregator. A state entry is marked verified only where a test reproduces a calculation the state itself published.

sources.title: PayStub Desk, how the figures are verified

resources.name: federal
resources.title: Federal percentage method, 2026
resources.description: IRS Publication 15-T percentage method: the standard and Step 2 bracket schedules and the standard deduction adjustment.

resources.name: fica
resources.title: Social Security and Medicare, 2026
resources.description: Social Security rate and wage base, Medicare rate, and the Additional Medicare rate with the threshold it starts at.

resources.name: state-income-tax
resources.title: State income tax withholding, 2026
resources.description: 54 withholding entries across 51 jurisdictions, 52 of them verified against a published calculation. More than one entry per state where a rate changed during the year, so the entry is chosen by pay date.

resources.name: state-other-withholding
resources.title: Other mandatory state withholdings, 2026
resources.description: 21 records across 16 states: disability, paid family and medical leave, and the other employee withholdings a state charges beside its income tax.

resources.name: control-examples
resources.title: Published calculations the tables are checked against
resources.description: 100 rows, each naming the document it came from: a worked example from a state guide, an answer from the calculator the state runs, a closed list of rates from the state's own form, or a printed withholding table read in at least two places. Each row carries its tolerance and why it has one.

resources.name: source-checks
resources.title: Source journal
resources.description: 92 rows recording when each source URL was last fetched and the hash of the text at that moment, including the one source that refuses automated requests.

resources.name: control-examples-csv
resources.title: Published calculations the tables are checked against, as a table
resources.description: The same 100 rows as control-examples.json, derived from it by the mirror on every run. Columns are the union of every key any row carries; a nested value sits in its cell as JSON.

resources.name: source-checks-csv
resources.title: Source journal, as a table
resources.description: The same 92 rows as source-checks.json, derived from it by the mirror on every run. Columns are the union of every key any row carries; a nested value sits in its cell as JSON.
